text:
Maria (CS): quick flag — Northridge Analytics down ~60% WAU over the last 3 weeks. renewal in 45d. their product lead (Aisha) just left; contact now is a contractor. I think we're at risk.
Juan (AM): ugh, when did Aisha leave? any note from customer success exec?
Maria (CS): their PM said last Friday. they told AMs in a short email, no handover yet. contractor is onboarding but seems tactical only.
RenewalBot: account_health_score: 47 (was 82 two months ago). last_active_seat: 2026-02-18. top_traffic_endpoints: embedding-create, chat-stream.
Priya (SE): can we pull recent call logs + example prompts? want to check if it's usage drop across teams or just the champion's seat. I can run a quick analysis.
Maria (CS): pls. I skimmed product logs — org-level calls down, but embeddings calls still steady from one bot user. most humans dropped.
Zac (Platform): I'll run a quick query:
```
SELECT count(distinct user_id) as active_seats, week
FROM events
WHERE account_id = 'northridge'
GROUP BY week
ORDER BY week DESC
LIMIT 6;
```
Zac (Platform): result: 8 -> 8 -> 6 -> 5 -> 3 -> 2 over six weeks.
Juan (AM): timeline bad. Renewal in 45d means we should start salvage play now. options: offer short-term dedicated trial, run a joint QBR + health audit, or engage their procurement with pricing incentive.
Maria (CS): agree. priority 1: re-establish champion. can we get a 1:1 with their new interim PM? I'll ask for a short call. priority 2: usage quick-win — propose a free 30k token burst for internal demos to re-engage stakeholders.
Priya (SE): technical ask — if contractor doesn't have permissions, demos won't run. propose we offer a temporary demo account pre-seeded with example prompts + quickstart notes. I can own the kit.
Juan (AM): i'll loop legal for a limited offer. also: heard procurement is running a bake-off with FlashServe. they asked for perf numbers last week.
Maria (CS): oh that's new — do we have perf/exportable benchmarks for our embeddings latency vs FlashServe?
Zac (Platform): we have a perf snapshot for the dedicated model stack. I'll produce a one-pager with p95 latency and cost-per-embedding. target by EOD.
RenewalBot: note created: "Northridge renew-risk — champion left, competitive eval flagged" (ticket #CS-8243). assigned to Maria, Juan.
Maria (CS): next steps: 
- Juan: confirm procurement timeline + who is running the bake-off.
- Zac: perf one-pager + current infra notes (quantization, batch config).
- Priya: demo kit + quickstart for interim PM.
- I'll schedule 15m intro call with interim PM and ask for a list of stakeholders.
Juan (AM): i'm on it. pinging @ProcurementOps to ask who the contact is and whether the bake-off has a scoring rubric.
Priya (SE): setting up a repo for the demo kit, will include a 2-min video, sample prompts, and a preloaded notebook.
Maria (CS): if we can get a 30m touch with the interim PM within 72h, we might re-light activity. if they confirm bake-off, we push perf + pricing.
Zac (Platform): one caveat — if they escalate to FlashServe for model features (LLM chain tooling), recommend we surface our rollout/fallback guarantees in the doc.
Juan (AM): noted. i've DMed CFO contact and procurement lead. will report back in this thread.
Maria (CS): thanks all. I'll post the calendar invite once I hear back from their contact. :eyes: 
Priya (SE): tagging final ask — give me 24h for demo kit.
Zac (Platform): perf one-pager done, uploading to drive: https://redwood.internal/share/northridge-perf-420101.
Maria (CS): adding a note: keep renewal flag high until first call. we'll treat as active escape plan.
Juan (AM): update — procurement replied, bake-off starts in 9 days, scorecard focused on latency, throughput, and ease-of-integration. they will accept a 2-week trial.
Maria (CS): perfect. i'll prioritize the 15m intro + request trial agreement.
RenewalBot: reminder scheduled in 72h: "Northridge outreach follow-up".
Maria (CS): end-of-thread: thanks team — small, tactical sprint. will update with outcomes after the intro call. :white_check_mark:
